description: The Mathematical Research Data Initiative and Xia Chen at the Technical University of Munich publish a synthetic building-energy table for causal-discovery experiments. The February 2026 deposit describes 918 rows and 31 variables, with raw and processed CSV files available free under MIT terms. Inputs cover geometry, envelope, heating systems, ventilation and occupant assumptions; the principal target is annual heating energy-use intensity in kilowatt-hours per square metre. These configurations and simulated outcomes can benchmark surrogate-building models or test sensitivity to dependent design choices. They are not observations of an actual building stock. Geographic deployment, simulation engine, weather year and ground-truth causal graph remain unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this table. The provider reports no missing values, but that claim and causal identifiability were not independently checked. Small size limits generalisation but does not remove the documented reuse value.
